title: Ranking-Preserving Coreset Selection for Efficient Evolutionary Hyperparameter Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.27959v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hyperparameter optimization (HPO) is essential for high predictive performance, but its computational cost becomes prohibitive when candidate configurations require repeated training on large datasets. This paper proposes a ranking-preserving coreset (RPC) selection framework for accelerating evolutionary HPO. The method constructs a compact coreset that preserves the relative ranking of hyperparameter configurations observed on the full training data. Coreset selection is formulated as an evolutionary optimization problem that maximizes Spearman rank correlation between full-data and subset-based configuration rankings while penalizing subset size. The selected coreset is then used for HPO with three evolutionary algorithms: Genetic Algorithm (GA), Cross-generational elitist Selection, Heterogeneous Recombination and Cataclysmic Mutation (CHC), and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO). translated_title: 用于高效进化超参数优化的保排序核心集选择
translated_abstract: 超参数优化（HPO）对于实现高预测性能至关重要，但当候选配置需要在大型数据集上进行反复训练时，其计算成本会变得极其高昂。本文提出了一种保排序核心集（RPC）选择框架，用于加速进化超参数优化。该方法构建一个紧凑的核心集，使其能够保留在完整训练数据上观察到的超参数配置的相对排序。核心集选择被表述为一个进化优化问题，其目标是在惩罚子集规模的同时，最大化基于完整数据与基于子集的配置排名之间的Spearman秩相关系数。随后，所选择的核心集被用于三种进化算法的超参数优化：遗传算法（GA）、跨代精英选择-异质重组-灾变变异算法（CHC）以及粒子群优化算法（PSO）。实验在七个表格数据集、两个文本数据集和两个图像数据集上进行。
tldr: 本文提出保排序核心集（RPC）选择框架，通过进化优化最大化核心集与完整数据上配置排名的Spearman秩相关，从而在保留超参数配置相对排序的前提下加速GA、CHC和PSO三种进化算法的超参数优化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a ranking-preserving coreset (RPC) selection framework that constructs a compact subset maximizing Spearman rank correlation between full-data and subset-based configuration rankings, thereby accelerating evolutionary hyperparameter optimization with GA, CHC, and PSO.
